soldier: Head brownish yellow, the anterior end darker in colour, mandibles blackish brown, labrum deep yellow, the small spot where the compound eye lies pale yellow, antennae brownish yellow with segment 3 darker. Pronotum brownish yellow, mesothorax, metathorax, legs and abdomen pale yellow, sternites pale white. The dorsum of the head, thorax and abdomen, as well as the antennae and legs, bear rather stout erect setae. Head capsule rectangular, the sides slightly parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded. Fontanelle in the centre of the frons, shaped like a small round dot, distinctly raised in lateral view. Labrum oval, the margin slightly transparent, the sides slightly parallel, the anterior end bluntly rounded and projecting forward, length and width almost equal. Mandibles stout, the apices rather pointed and slightly curved, the middle to lower part of the inner margin of each mandible with a minute tooth-like process. Antennae 13–14-segmented, segment 3 the thickest and longest, obconical, segments 2 and 4 almost equal in length. Eyes circular, situated beside the antennal bases at the front of the head, not projecting. Pronotum kidney-shaped, the anterior margin broad and deeply concave, the anterior part broader, the anterior lateral angles rounded, the lateral margins sloping backwards and contracting, the posterior margin slightly concave at the middle.
